items.title: Karnataka CM orders probe after police stop three Dalit Ministers at Mysuru Dasara
items.summary: Karnataka Chief Minister DK Shivakumar on Thursday, October 22, ordered an inquiry into an incident in which police personnel stopped three Dalit ministers from proceeding to the Nandidhwaja Pooja at Mysuru Palace on Tuesday. Shivakumar directed Chief Secretary Shalini Rajneesh to identify those responsible and submit a report. “The officials acted high-handedly by restricting the ministers. I intervened immediately to facilitate their entry. Such irresponsibility cannot be tolerated. I have therefore ordered the Chief Secretary to conduct an inquiry and submit a report,” Shivakumar said. Video footage shows Ministers PM Narendraswamy, KS Basavantappa and Shivaraj Tangadagi being stopped by a police officer as they followed the Chief Minister towards the venue of the ritual.
